test_item_verbatim: The Head Unit shall gate FD-CAN8 TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition when Hybrid_Type != "Range Electric Paradigm Breaker" OR "Battery Electric Vehicle"

tcs.tc_title: gate ShiftLeverPosition to ShiftLeverPosition, set the CAN signal and read vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition
tcs.pre_conditions:
1. The HU is in the Full-Operation state
2. PROXI Rear_View_Camera = 1 (Present)
3. A bus analyzer is connected to the LVDS link between the HU and the RVCM
tcs.test_procedure:
1. Send CAN: TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition = 2 (R)
2. Read vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition and check that it reports the value sent in step 1
tcs.expected_result:
1. TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition = 2 (R) is sent
2. vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition reports the same value and is sent over LVDS
tcs.design_method: 功能測試 (Functional based ; no specific technique)
tcs.test_item:
The Head Unit shall gate FD-CAN8 TRANSM_FD_4.ShiftLeverPosition to LVDS vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition when Hybrid_Type != "Range Electric Paradigm Breaker" OR "Battery Electric Vehicle"

(gate ShiftLeverPosition to ShiftLeverPosition, set the CAN signal and read vehicleUpdate_2.ShiftLeverPosition)

reasoning: 驗證目標為 `SYS-RA-VF551_V2-747`（`VF551_V2_PDT27` 前綴）之 DT27 分支。**與 `-156` 之逐字差別在 hybrid 型別之列舉** —— DT27 本寫 `"Range Electric Paradigm Breaker" OR "Battery Electric Vehicle"`，HDCC27 本寫 `… OR "Fuel Cell Electric Vehicle"`，故拆列而非同義列。LVDS 訊號無 DBC（四本零命中），其值以來源 label 逐字書寫、觀察以 bus analyzer 進行，**不造命令**（profile §7.2／§7.3）。
